chemistry_notes.text: Type II singlet-O2 photosensitization: 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole absorbs at 420 nm, undergoes ISC to T1, sensitizes triplet O2 to singlet O2, which selectively oxidizes the thioether of Fmoc-L-methionine to sulfoxide via a persulfoxide intermediate. Key flow advantages: (1) 1 mm ID PFA coil gives ~4x shorter optical path vs batch flask, improving photon delivery; (2) segmented gas-liquid flow in 1 mm tubing dramatically increases kLa for O2 mass transfer vs batch headspace diffusion. Engineering calculations flag O2 transfer sufficiency at 0.19x at low gas flows — MFC starting point raised to 5.0 sccm to increase gas-liquid interfacial area. Residence time basis is inlet/STP apparent: V_reactor=1 mL, Q_liquid=0.5 mL/min, Q_gas_STP=5.0 sccm=5.0 mL/min; t_inlet = 1 mL / (0.5 + 5.0) mL/min = 0.18 min. This is very short; if conversion is incomplete, reduce liquid flow rate to 0.1–0.2 mL/min to extend residence time. The 1 mL reactor is the only available reactor (inventory constraint) — the engineering calculation sized 4.86 mL but this is not available; the 1 mL reactor must be used and liquid flow rate adjusted accordingly. BPR at 3.0 bar maintains gas solubility and prevents uncontrolled degassing. Fmoc group is stable under neutral photochemical conditions; no base or nucleophile present. Over-oxidation to sulfone is a known risk — residence time must be validated experimentally. Analogies 1, 2, 3 all confirm 420 nm LED, PFA/FEP tubing, 1 mm ID, and short residence times (1.25–30 min) for visible-light photocatalysis in flow; Analogy 3 (MeCN solvent, 420 nm, 1 mm ID, 1.25 min) is most directly applicable.

gas_flow_sccm.text: Air MFC [mfc_air_10] set to 5.0 sccm STP. Range 0.1–10 sccm. Engineering calculation: 5.34 sccm for gas:liquid ratio targeting O2 sufficiency. Starting at 5.0 sccm (within MFC range, close to calculated value). O2 transfer sufficiency flagged at 0.19x in calculations — higher gas flow selected to improve interfacial area. Analogy 1 (Similarity 0.152): photoredox with Ir catalyst, 425 nm, DMSO, 30 min residence — chemically different (radical addition vs singlet-O2, no gas feed) — not directly applicable for gas flow parameters. Analogy 2 (Similarity 0.137): CMB-C3N4 heterogeneous photocatalysis, 420 nm, MeCN:H2O, N2 atmosphere — different mechanism and no O2 gas feed — not applicable for gas parameters. Analogy 3 (Similarity 0.132): PDI photocatalyst, 420 nm, MeCN, 1 mm ID, 1.25 min — most similar solvent/wavelength/tubing but N2 atmosphere, no gas-liquid O2 feed — gas flow must be set from engineering calculation.

chemistry_notes.text: Type II singlet-O2 photosensitization: 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole absorbs at 420 nm, undergoes ISC to T1, sensitizes triplet O2 to singlet O2, which selectively oxidizes the thioether of Fmoc-L-methionine to sulfoxide via a persulfoxide intermediate. Key flow advantages: (1) 1 mm ID PFA coil gives ~4x shorter optical path vs batch flask, improving photon delivery; (2) segmented gas-liquid flow in 1 mm tubing dramatically increases kLa for O2 mass transfer vs batch headspace diffusion. Engineering calculations flag O2 transfer sufficiency at 0.19x at low gas flows — MFC starting point raised to 5.0 sccm to increase gas-liquid interfacial area. Residence time basis is inlet/STP apparent: V_reactor=1 mL, Q_liquid=0.5 mL/min, Q_gas_STP=5.0 sccm=5.0 mL/min; t_inlet = 1 mL / (0.5 + 5.0) mL/min = 0.18 min. This is very short; if conversion is incomplete, reduce liquid flow rate to 0.1–0.2 mL/min to extend residence time. The 1 mL reactor is the only available reactor (inventory constraint) — the engineering calculation sized 4.86 mL but this is not available; the 1 mL reactor must be used and liquid flow rate adjusted accordingly. BPR at 3.0 bar maintains gas solubility and prevents uncontrolled degassing. Fmoc group is stable under neutral photochemical conditions; no base or nucleophile present. Over-oxidation to sulfone is a known risk — residence time must be validated experimentally. Analogies 1, 2, 3 all confirm 420 nm LED, PFA/FEP tubing, 1 mm ID, and short residence times (1.25–30 min) for visible-light photocatalysis in flow; Analogy 3 (MeCN solvent, 420 nm, 1 mm ID, 1.25 min) is most directly applicable.
chemistry_notes.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety
